8996-practical-suggestions-for-mother-an.description: A book by MARION MILLS MILLER, Litt D.. CHAPTER V THE HOUSE Essential parts of a house. How to read a gas-meter. How to test kerosene. Making the best of the old house. CHAPTER VI FURNITURE AND DECORATION The qualities to be sought in furniture. Good furniture as an investment. Furnishing and decorating the hall. arxiv-2203-02542.title: Resonance X ⁡ ( 4630 ) X(4630)
arxiv-2203-02542.creator: S. S. Agaev, K. Azizi, H. Sundu
arxiv-2203-02542.description: Abstract We investigate the structure X ⁡ ( 4630 ) X(4630) discovered by the LHCb collaboration in the process B + → J / ψ ​ ϕ ​ K + B^{+}\rightarrow J/\psi\phi K^{+} as a resonance in the J / ψ ​ ϕ J/\psi\phi mass distribution.

arxiv-2209-05578.title: Cocktail Party Attack: Breaking Aggregation-Based Privacy in Federated Learning using Independent Component Analysis † {\dagger} work was done while the authors were at FAIR/Meta AI.
arxiv-2209-05578.creator: Sanjay Kariyappa †, Chuan Guo, Kiwan Maeng †, Wenjie Xiong, G. Edward Suh, Moinuddin K Qureshi, Hsien-Hsin S. Lee †
arxiv-2209-05578.description: Abstract Federated learning (FL) aims to perform privacy-preserving machine learning on distributed data held by multiple data owners. To this end, FL requires the data owners to perform training locally and share the gradient updates (instead of the private inputs) with the central server, which are then securely aggregated over multiple data owners.

arxiv-2211-03247.title: Optical scattering imaging with sub-nanometer precision based on position-ultra-sensitive giant Lamb shift Journal: opticajournal Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2211-03247.creator: Zeyang Liao, 1,# Yuwei Lu, 1,# and Xue-Hua Wang 1,*
arxiv-2211-03247.description: Abstract The Lamb shift of a quantum emitter very close to a plasmonic nanostructure, mainly induced by the higher-order plasmonic dark modes, can be three or more orders of magnitude larger than that in the free space and it is ultra-sensitive to the emitter position and polarization.

arxiv-2302-02102.title: Amazon Last-Mile Delivery Trajectory Prediction Using Hierarchical TSP with Customized Cost Matrix
arxiv-2302-02102.creator: Xiaotong Guo, Baichuan Mo, Qingyi Wang
arxiv-2302-02102.description: Abstract In response to the Amazon Last-Mile Routing Challenge, Team Permission Denied proposes a hierarchical Travelling Salesman Problem (TSP) optimization with a customized cost matrix. The higher level TSP solves for the zone sequence while the lower level TSP solves the intra-zonal stop sequence. The cost matrix is modified to account for routing patterns beyond the shortest travel time.

arxiv-2401-10624.title: Proximal gradient methods with inexact oracle of degree q q for composite optimization
arxiv-2401-10624.creator: Yassine Nabou, François Glineur, Ion Necoara
arxiv-2401-10624.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yassine Nabou, François Glineur, Ion Necoara. We introduce the concept of inexact first-order oracle of degree q q for a possibly nonconvex and nonsmooth function, which naturally appears in the context of approximate gradient, weak level of smoothness and other situations. Our definition is less conservative than those found in the existing literature, and it can be viewed as an interpolation between fully exact and the existing inexact first-order oracle definitions.

arxiv-2404-02433.title: A fast cosine transformation accelerated method for predicting effective thermal conductivity
arxiv-2404-02433.creator: Changqing Ye, Shubin Fu, and Eric T. Chung
arxiv-2404-02433.description: Abstract Predicting effective thermal conductivity by solving a Partial Differential Equation (PDE) defined on a high-resolution Representative Volume Element (RVE) is a computationally intensive task. In this paper, we tackle the task by proposing an efficient and implementation-friendly computational method that can fully leverage the computing power offered by hardware accelerators, namely, graphical processing units (GPUs).

arxiv-2405-17320.title: An explicit formula of the parameter dependence of de partial derivatives of the Green’s functions related to arbitrary two-point boundary conditions
arxiv-2405-17320.creator: Alberto Cabada, Lucía López-Somoza
arxiv-2405-17320.description: Abstract In this paper we obtain an explicit formula of the parameter dependence of the partial derivatives of the Green’s functions related to two-point boundary conditions. Such expression follows as an integral of both kernels times the difference of the corresponding parameters of each Green’s function.

arxiv-2408-05775.title: Efficient Test-Time Prompt Tuning for Vision-Language Models
arxiv-2408-05775.creator: Yuhan Zhu, Guozhen Zhang, Chen Xu, Haocheng Shen, Xiaoxin Chen, Gangshan Wu, Limin Wang
arxiv-2408-05775.description: Abstract Vision-language models have showcased impressive zero-shot classification capabilities when equipped with suitable text prompts. Previous studies have shown the effectiveness of test-time prompt tuning; however, these methods typically require per-image prompt adaptation during inference, which incurs high computational budgets and limits scalability and practical deployment.

arxiv-2408-09490.title: Leveraging Invariant Principle for Heterophilic Graph Structure Distribution Shifts
arxiv-2408-09490.creator: Jinluan Yang, Zhengyu Chen, Teng Xiao, Yong Lin, Wenqiao Zhang, Kun Kuang
arxiv-2408-09490.description: Abstract . Heterophilic Graph Neural Networks (HGNNs) have shown promising results for semi-supervised learning tasks on graphs. Notably, most real-world heterophilic graphs are composed of a mixture of nodes with different neighbor patterns, exhibiting local node-level homophilic and heterophilic structures.

pmc-11613704.title: Adverse Ocular Impact and Emerging Therapeutic Potential of Cannabis and Cannabinoids: A Narrative Review
pmc-11613704.creator: Mostafa Bondok, Anne Xuan-Lan Nguyen, Leonardo Lando, Albert Y Wu
pmc-11613704.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Cannabis is the most used drug worldwide with an estimated 219 million users. This narrative review aims to explore the adverse effects and therapeutic applications of cannabis and cannabinoids on the eye, given its growing clinical and non-clinical uses. The current literature reports several adverse ocular effects of cannabis and cannabinoids, including eyelid tremor, ptosis, reduced corneal endothelial cell density, dry eyes, red eyes, and neuro-retinal dysfunction.

pmc-12056441.title: Exploring the Physical and Mental Health Challenges of Teenage Pregnancy: A Qualitative Study in the Tamale Metropolis, Ghana
pmc-12056441.creator: Rafatu Tahiru, Comfort Kona, Abiba Nyari, Tawfik Mohammed, Dorothy Anukem Pawmang
pmc-12056441.description: Objective:Teenage pregnancy poses significant public health challenges globally, particularly affecting the physical and mental well-being of adolescent girls. Despite a global decline in teenage birth rates, regions like sub-Saharan Africa continue to experience high prevalence. In Ghana’s Tamale metropolis, teenage pregnancy rates have shown a concerning rise, underscoring the need for an in-depth exploration of its multifaceted impacts.

pmc-12392606.title: Threat context impairs cognitive control of neutral words processing in social anxiety individuals: evidence from ERP and theta oscillations
pmc-12392606.creator: Haiyan Zhao, Feng Si, Hui Meng, Haibo Yang, Dawei Sun, Longyan Peng, Jianqin Cao
pmc-12392606.description: BackgroundSocial anxiety (SA) is characterized by cognitive control impairments, particularly in the processing of threat, yet how threat-laden environments modulate cognitive control over neutral stimuli remains unclear. This study examined whether threat context impairs the processing of neutral words in individuals with high social anxiety (HSA) through electrophysiological and oscillatory dynamics.MethodsA total of 151 participants (HSA vs.

pmc-12605861.title: Cross-cultural adaption and psychometric validation of Importance of Good Death-Indonesian version for patients with advanced cancer
pmc-12605861.creator: Wahyu Dewi Sulistyarini, Sheng-Yu Fan, Mei-Chih Huang, Christantie Effendy, Dongjuan Xu, Ting-Jyun Chen, Chi-Yin Kao
pmc-12605861.description: ObjectiveTo adapt and test the psychometric properties of the Importance of Good Death Questionnaire for Indonesian patients with advanced cancer.MethodsThe original instrument underwent a rigorous process of forward and backward translation, complemented by an expert panel review to ensure cultural and conceptual equivalence and to evaluate content validity.

pmc-12630111.title: Trehalose alleviates nephropathy in focal segmental glomerulosclerosis via the upregulation of the WT-1/EZH2 pathway
pmc-12630111.creator: Maha Al-Asmakh, Marwa AL Riyami, Miytha Al Marbuii, Shadia Al Sinawi, Suaad Al-Badi, Faisal AL Ismaili, Amira AlKharusi, Razan Zadjali, Zaina Alharthi, Sara Al Mashrafi, Razan Al Breiki, Sulaiman Al-Hashmi, Ali Al Lawati, Amal Kassab, Fahad Zadjali
pmc-12630111.description: IntroductionFocal segmental glomerulosclerosis (FSGS) is a serious disease that culminates in kidney failure. Today, FSGS is diagnosed histologically as a progressive scarring of the glomeruli due to gradual loss or damage of the podocyte layer, making it one of the main targets of FSGS therapeutic approaches.

pmc-12765006.title: Personality and impulsivity traits associated with problematic online gaming and poker playing
pmc-12765006.creator: Eleonora Anci, Stephane Rothen, Christophe Tra, Magdalena Liberacka-Dwojak, Lucien Rochat, Monika Wiłkosc-Debczynska, Vladan Starcevic, David Berle, Christina Athanasopoulou, Germano Vera Cruz, Seung-Yup Lee, Sophia Achab, Gabriel Thorens, Daniele Zullino, Joel Billieux, Yasser Khazaal
pmc-12765006.description: Online gambling and gaming are associated with Problematic Usage of the Internet (PUI) in subgroups of individuals. This study aimed to assess how different personality dimensions are associated with PUI scores of Massively Multiplayer Online Role Playing Games (MMORPG) players and online poker players, and to characterize common and specific personality traits of both groups in their association with PUI.

pmc-13008890.title: Host–gut microbiota interactions in health and disease: mechanisms and intervention strategies
pmc-13008890.creator: Yu Han, Zian Wang, Jiahao Xie, Guangdi Yang, Monong Su, Siqi Wang, Mengxin Yang, Huiyang Yu, Minghua Li, Liang Wang, Yunying Zhang, Binbin Hou
pmc-13008890.description: The mammalian gut microbiota is a complex and dynamic “microbial organ” that interacts with its host. The gut microbiota contains a vast gene pool and metabolic capacity, producing key metabolites such as short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs), bile acids, vitamins, and other compounds.

pmc-13074307.title: Dietary Management After Ulcerative Colitis Surgery: A Thematic Analysis of TikTok Content
pmc-13074307.creator: Oliver R. Kaye, Dakota R. Rhys-Jones, Orestis Argyriou, Sue Blackwell, Emma P. Halmos, Zaid Ardalan, Janindra Warusavitarne, Kapil Sahnan, Jonathan P. Segal, Ailsa L. Hart, Chu K. Yao, Itai Ghersin
pmc-13074307.description: Background/Objectives: For patients with Ulcerative Colitis (UC) requiring surgical treatment, post-operative dietary management can pose significant challenges. TikTok is emerging as a popular social media platform for dissemination of health and nutrition information. The aim of this study is to analyse patient-generated content on TikTok regarding dietary management post-UC surgery, in order to identify recurring themes and highlight patient priorities.

pmc-13075779.title: Emerging imaging modalities for the diagnosis of malignant lesions of the male reproductive tract in companion animals
pmc-13075779.creator: Diego Rodrigues Gomes, Anna Carolina Mazeto Ercolin, Gabriela Castro Lopes Evangelista, Felipe Farias Pereira da Câmara Barros, Camila Silveira Stanquini, Camila Debastiani, Fredderico Garcia, Marcus Antônio Rossi Feliciano
pmc-13075779.description: Understanding diseases that affect the male reproductive system of dogs and cats is important for improving their health and quality of life. Imaging techniques, such as ultrasound and X-rays, play a fundamental role in the evaluation of this system. They help veterinarians detect problems in the testicles, prostate, and other reproductive organs of dogs and cats.

pmc-13181959.title: Preoperative clinical-imaging nomogram for peritoneal metastasis in gastric cancer: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-13181959.creator: Suxia Qi, Hong Zhang, Yongzhi Lu
pmc-13181959.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectiveTo explore the preoperative predictive factors for peritoneal metastasis in patients with advanced gastric cancer and construct a nomogram prediction model combining clinical and radiomics features.MethodsA total of 342 patients with advanced gastric cancer who were scheduled to undergo surgical treatment were selected and randomly divided into a training set (239 cases) and a validation set (103 cases) at a ratio of 7:3.

pmc-13289327.creator: Asako Mito, Hasumi Tomita, Noriyuki Iwama, Shiori Kawai, Daniel Helkey, Taku Obara, Robert J Huang, Hirotaka Hamada, Aoi Noda, Mami Ishikuro, Shinichi Kuriyama, Fumiaki Ikeno, Naoko Arata, Masatoshi Saito, Latha Palaniappan, Adrian M Bacong

pmc-13342563.title: Atlantic meridional overturning circulation slowdown modulates atmospheric rivers in a warmer climate
pmc-13342563.creator: Mohima Sultana Mimi, Wei Liu, Weiming Ma, Gang Chen
pmc-13342563.description: The slowing of the Atlantic meridional overturning circulation (AMOC) under anthropogenic warming has been suggested to significantly impact Earth’s climate. Here, we isolate and quantify the AMOC impact on atmospheric rivers (ARs) across the twenty-first century using coupled climate model simulations.

pmc-13368761.title: Combined bidirectional spinal cord stimulation for refractory neuropathic pelvic pain: a case report
pmc-13368761.creator: Yakov Perper, Alana Taub, Jenifer Perper
pmc-13368761.description: IntroductionRefractory neuropathic pelvic pain significantly impairs quality of life and is notoriously difficult to treat. We present the case of a 63-year-old woman who developed severe pelvic pain following emergency open thoracic aortic aneurysm repair. Despite extensive pharmacologic, non-pharmacologic, and interventional treatments, she experienced minimal relief.

pmc-13371608.title: Preserving Shell Integrity of Microgastropods With the Nondestructive HotSHOT DNA Extraction Method
pmc-13371608.creator: Nina Tombers, Cristina Vasilița, Ira Richling
pmc-13371608.description: Gastropods rank among the most species‐rich animal classes, accounting for 5% (4–8) of all described animal species with about 1/3 of microgastropods (< 5 mm in size). DNA extraction from preserved microgastropods retracted into their shells is challenging because established methods usually damage the shell.

pmc-13457054.title: Development and validation of a robust logistic regression model for predicting osteoporosis in older people
pmc-13457054.creator: Hongxia Xue, Xuewei Hao, Dandan Liu, Yongqiang Li, Haiquan Yu

pmc-13530638.title: Poster 180. Comparing the Efficacy of Minimal Clinically Important Difference Thresholds using Distribution-Based or Anchor-Based Estimations: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-13530638.creator: Brandon J. Allen, Jackson Woodrow, Maya S. Dubrovsky, Rachel L. Poutre, Rishi P. Earla, Jeffrey S. Mun, Stephen M. Gillinov, Bilal Siddiq, Nathan J. Cherian, Ryan E. Dean, Scott D. Martin
pmc-13530638.description: Objective:In orthopaedic literature, the minimal clinically important difference (MCID) is a common threshold used to calculate the smallest change in a patient-reported outcome measure (PROM) that a patient would identify as an improvement after treatment. However, thresholds can vary widely and be calculated in two ways: either by distribution or anchor-based methods.
